spans.s: हूड् vt. 1Ā (pres. हूडते) To go, to move.
हुड m. 1. A ram; 2. an iron club; 3. an iron stake for keeping out thieves.
हुडु m. A ram, जंबुको हुडुयुद्धेन Panch.i.
हुडुक्क m. 1. A small hour-glass-shaped drum; 2. the bolt of a door; 3. a drunken man; 4. a kind of bird (दात्यूह).
हुडुत n. 1. Noise of a ball; 2. any indistinct noise.
